midagi sellist?!
{07 1b 00}Kas sa olid NII kade, et
pööran tähelepanu

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 14 00}{07 04 00}Ugh,{01 00 00 05 00} how can you be so
calm?! How can you even
look me in the eye?!
{07 15 00}That present{01 00 00 0a 00} I gave you to
deliver to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
You opened it, didn't you?
{07 05 00}I can't believe that!{01 00 00 14 00} {01 00 00 05 00}It's a
total violation of privacy!
{01 00 00 0a 00}You're a terrible snoop!!{03 02 00 01}

suudad mulle silma vaadata?
{07 15 00}See kingitus,{01 00 00 0a 00} mille andsin
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} kätte viia{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
